command:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/repository')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'status','--porcelain']) == b''
assert not pathlib.Path('/workspace/.aiec-repo-objects').exists()
original=(root/'README').read_bytes()
assert b'CACHE_ISOLATION_MARKER' not in original
actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert actual=='7fd1a60b01f91b314f59955a4e4d4e80d8edf11d'
interfaces={}
for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/net/dev').read_text().splitlines()[2:]:
 name,columns=line.split(':',1); fields=columns.split()
 if name.strip()!='lo': interfaces[name.strip()]={'rx':int(fields[0]),'tx':int(fields[8])}
(root/'README').write_bytes(original+b'\nCACHE_ISOLATION_MARKER\n')
print(json.dumps({'interfaces':interfaces,'rx':sum(v['rx'] for v in interfaces.values()),'tx':sum(v['tx'] for v in interfaces.values()),'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),'commit':actual,'fresh_clean_checkout':True,'private_mirror_absent':True},sort_keys=True))
